verdict.rationale: Orrick's Tech Studio explicitly offers 50+ free, no-registration document generators and forms (e.g., Convertible Note/Term Sheet Creator, Incorporation Questionnaire) covering incorporation, term sheets, and related startup paperwork, and community testimony corroborates founders actually using these free docs to form companies without being clients (orrick-supp-studio-open-source, orrick-supp-note-term-sheet-creator, orrick-supp-germany-incorporation-form, orrick-comm-6, orrick-comm-7). Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of a dedicated SAFE generator and NDA template are not directly named in the evidence, only implied by broader 'forms' and community comparison to comprehensive doc sets.
